title: Input Under Inspection
summary: Observe unsafe query handling in a synthetic local application.
description: A deliberately vulnerable training endpoint searches a small fictional dataset by concatenating user input into a SQL query. Use only this local target and synthetic data. Document evidence of the unsafe behaviour and recommend parameterised queries. This is a learning demonstration, not guidance for testing real sites.

workspace_seed.app.py:
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
import sqlite3, json
DB='/workspace/training.sqlite'
con=sqlite3.connect(DB); con.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS people (id INTEGER, name TEXT, role TEXT)'); con.execute('DELETE FROM people'); con.executemany('INSERT INTO people VALUES (?,?,?)',[(1,'Mira','analyst'),(2,'Noah','operator'),(3,'Isha','researcher')]); con.commit(); con.close()
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  p=urlparse(self.path)
  if p.path!='/search': self.send_response(404); self.end_headers(); return
  q=parse_qs(p.query).get('q',[''])[0]
  # INTENTIONALLY VULNERABLE: training-only unsafe string concatenation.
  con=sqlite3.connect(DB)
  try: rows=con.execute("SELECT id,name,role FROM people WHERE name LIKE '%"+q+"%'").fetchall(); body=json.dumps({'results':[{'id':r[0],'name':r[1],'role':r[2]} for r in rows]}).encode(); self.send_response(200)
  except Exception as e: body=json.dumps({'error':'query failed'}).encode(); self.send_response(400)
  finally: con.close()
  self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
 def log_message(self,*a): pass
HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',8080),Handler).serve_forever()
workspace_seed.readme.txt: Local-only deliberately vulnerable app. Endpoint: GET /search?q=NAME. Synthetic records.
